data.name: AlHaythamiyya
data.gender_notes: AlHaythamiyya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Al-Haytham' - the name of a renowned Islamic scholar, Al-Haythamiyya symbolizes the one who enlightens others by providing explanations and guidance, especially in religious matters. The name AlHaythamiyya carries the meaning “The One Who Gives Explanations” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHaythamiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who gives explanations and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of knowledge and wisdom, enlightening the path for others.
data.etymology: AlHaythamiyya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Who Gives Explanations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHaythamiyya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: الهيثمية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من هيثم، يعني النور والضياء والبصيرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الهيثمية اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من اسم هيثم الذي يعني النور والضياء والبصيرة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ١٢٣ {وَكَذَلِكَ أَخَذَ رَبُّكَ إِذًا وَأَثَابَ بَعْضًا وَأَثَابَ بَعْضًا عَلَى مَا كَانُوا يَسْتَعِزُّونَ} حيث يوصف الله تعالى بأنه يضل من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العصور الإسلامية كدلالة على الإيمان والهداية.

in_urdu.name: الہیثمیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نور، روشنی، بصیرت، حق کی راہ پر چلنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہیثمیہ ایک مؤنث اسم ہے جو 'ہيثم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نور، روشنی، یا بصیرت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک مثبت معانی رکھتا ہے اور اس کا استعمال مسلم والدین اپنے بچوں کو صحیح راستے پر چلنے کی دعا کے طور پر کرتے ہیں۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، خاص طور پر سورة الأنعام میں جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ کا فیصلہ ان پر واضح ہوتا ہے جو ضلالت میں ہیں اور جو هدایت یافتہ ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अलहैथमिया
in_hindi.meaning: नूर, रोशनी, बुद्धि, सत्य के मार्ग पर चलने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलहैथमिया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो 'हैथम' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है नूर, रोशनी, या बुद्धि। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक सकारात्मक अर्थ रखता है और मुस्लिम माता-पिता अपने बच्चों को सही रास्ते पर चलने की دعा के रूप में इसका उपयोग करते हैं। इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है, विशेष रूप से सूरा अल-अनआम में जहां अल্লাহ का फैसला उन पर स्पष्ट होता है जो भटक गए हैं और जो निर्देशित हैं।

in_pashto.name: الهیثمیه
in_pashto.meaning: رڼا، نور، لارښود، د حق لارې پيروي کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: الهیثمیه یوه ښځینه نوم دی چې د 'هيثم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د رڼا، نور، یا لارښود دی. دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې مثبت معنی لري او مسلمان والدین خپلو ماشومانو ته د سمو لارې د پيروي دعا په توګه کاروي. دا په قران کريم کې هم ذکر شوی، په ځانګړي ډول د انعام سورت کې چې د الله تعالیٰ فيصله د هغو کسانو په اړه روښانه ده چې گمراه شوي او هغه کسان چې لارښود شوي.

in_english.name: AlHaythamiyya
in_english.meaning: Derived from Haytham, meaning light, guidance, and insight
in_english.long_meaning: AlHaythamiyya is a feminine name derived from the Arabic name Haytham, which means light, guidance, or insight. This name holds a positive connotation in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the pursuit of knowledge and spiritual guidance. It is mentioned in the Quran, particularly in Surah Al-An'am, where Allah's decree for those who are misled and those who are guided is made clear. The name reflects the values of wisdom, enlightenment, and adherence to the right path.

data.cultural_impact: The name "AlHaythamiyya" hails from 'Al-Haytham', a renowned scholar and scientist of the Islamic Golden Age, recognized for his greatest contributions to literature on mathematics, astronomy, and optics. The name echoes more than just history and knowledge, but the courage to innovate, question, and Seek Divine wisdom. Today, being part of the AlHaythamiyya community symbolizes an individual's dedication in continuing the legacy of Al-Haytham – providing guidance and education, pushing the boundaries of knowledge, and preserving the essence of Islamic heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The term 'AlHaythamiyya' signifies more than the historical figure it derives from – it's a spiritual calling. In understanding the name's origin comes the reminder that enlightenment goes beyond mere knowledge. It's seeing truth and wisdom in every aspect of life, as Al-Haytham did in his scientific pursuits, and in turn, sharing this illumination with others. As part of this distinguished name, one is encouraged to practice a deep, introspective spirituality, seeking knowledge that nourishes the soul, and striving to enlighten others throughout life's continual journey.
